newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITSUI CON BID-ONLY AFTER RESTRUCTURE AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: MITSUI CON BID-ONLY AFTER RESTRUCTURE AGREEMENT.

text.p: Shares of Mitsui Construction Co Ltd were bid-only on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in early Thursday morning trade after the company announced on Wednesday that the Mitsui industrial group would support its restructuring.
At 0010 GMT, Mitsui Construction shares were bid-only at 175 yen.

The TSE suspended trade in Mitsui Construction shares on Wednesday afternoon, in order to give the market time to get clarification of the restructuring plan. Prior to the suspension the shares were trading at 170 yen, up 11 yen from Tuesday's close.
Mitsui Construction announced on Wednesday that it had formed a three-year restructuring plan which would be implemented with support from member companies of the Mitsui group.

Four financial institutions in the group -- Sakura Bank Ltd, Mitsui Trust & Banking Co Ltd, Mitsui Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd and Mitsui Mutual Life Insurance Co -- would all provide financial support and other member companies in the industrial group will also offer help, the builder said.
